name: Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2001, Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd provides environmental IT solutions through software applications and compliance solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TGSL is an ISO 9001-2015 and NABET accredited firm. It has executed 2,500+ projects across the environment domain including compliances, complex consulting projects, research and implemented numerous environmental technology solutions

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.6%
Debtor days have improved from 285 to 118 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
